design_overview: A modern, clean flower delivery app design with emphasis on visual product presentation, intuitive navigation, and seamless checkout flow. The design prioritizes large product imagery, clear call-to-actions, and a warm color palette that reflects the natural beauty of flowers. The interface follows iOS/Android native patterns with bottom tab navigation for customers and a comprehensive admin dashboard for order management.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main landing screen showcasing featured flowers, categories, and quick access to shopping

key_components.name: Top Header
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, contains app logo on left and shopping cart icon on right with badge showing item count
key_components.interaction: Cart icon navigates to Shopping Cart screen

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Light gray rounded rectangle with search icon, placeholder text 'Search flowers...'
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens search screen with keyboard

key_components.name: Hero Banner
key_components.styling: Full-width card with gradient overlay (pink to transparent), rounded corners, displays seasonal promotion
key_components.interaction: Taps navigate to featured collection

key_components.name: Categories Section Header
key_components.styling: Bold text 'Shop by Category' with 'See All' link on right
key_components.interaction: See All navigates to Categories screen

key_components.name: Category Cards
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable list of rounded square cards, each with category image, name overlay, white text with semi-transparent dark background
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to category detail with filtered flowers

key_components.name: Featured Flowers Header
key_components.styling: Bold text 'Featured Flowers' with filter icon on right
key_components.interaction: Filter icon opens filter modal

key_components.name: Flower Product Cards
key_components.styling: Vertical grid (2 columns) of white cards with rounded corners, shadow, product image at top, flower name, price in bold, rating stars, heart icon for wishlist
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Flower Detail screen, heart icon toggles wishlist

key_components.name: Quick Add Button
key_components.styling: Small circular button with plus icon, primary color background, positioned on bottom right of each product card
key_components.interaction: Adds item to cart with default quantity, shows brief success toast

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White background with subtle top border, 4 tabs with icons and labels: Home, Categories, Orders, Profile
key_components.interaction: Each tab navigates to respective screen, active tab highlighted in primary color

screens.user_flow: Entry point of app → Browse categories or featured flowers → Tap product to view details or quick add to cart → Navigate to other sections via bottom tabs

screens.name: Flower Detail

key_components.name: Product Image Gallery

key_components.name: Product Info Card
key_components.styling: White card with rounded top corners, contains flower name (large bold), category tag (small chip), price (large bold primary color), availability status

key_components.name: Rating Summary

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White background, 'Description' header, body text with line spacing, expandable if text is long

key_components.styling: Bold text 'Customer Reviews' with 'See All' link

key_components.name: Add to Cart Button

key_components.name: Cart Header

key_components.name: Empty Cart State

key_components.name: Promo Code Input

key_components.name: Checkout Button

key_components.name: Continue Shopping Link

key_components.interaction: Tap to enter special delivery notes

key_components.name: Payment Method Card
key_components.styling: White card with 'Payment Method' header, selected payment method with card icon and last 4 digits, 'Change' link

key_components.name: Order Items Summary
key_components.styling: White card with 'Order Summary' header, list of items with small thumbnails, names, quantities, 'View Details' link

key_components.styling: Secondary color outlined button with text 'Contact Support', centered

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices. Layouts use flexible containers and responsive grids. Product cards adjust from 2 columns on phones to 3-4 columns on tablets. Bottom navigation remains fixed on mobile, converts to side navigation on tablets. Touch targets minimum 44x44px. Images use responsive sizing with aspect ratio preservation. Admin dashboard uses collapsible sections on mobile, expanded multi-column layout on tablets.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios meet 4.5:1 for text. Icons paired with text labels. Form inputs have clear labels and error states. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation support. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Alternative text for all images. Status updates announced to screen readers.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability without distraction. Button taps show 95% scale with spring animation (200ms). Screen transitions use native slide animations (300ms ease-out). Card taps show subtle elevation increase. Loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect. Success actions show checkmark animation with scale and fade. Add to cart shows item flying to cart icon. Pull-to-refresh uses native platform patterns. Status changes animate with smooth color transitions.
icons: Consistent icon set throughout app using outlined style for secondary actions, filled style for active/primary states. Icons: home (house), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (wishlist), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow). All icons 24x24px default size, scalable for larger touch targets.
